message.content:
An editorial illustration features a large gray dump truck with a white cabin against a gray background. A man with tan skin and short dark hair, wearing a white collared shirt, sits in the driver’s seat. The truck's bed is raised at a steep angle, dumping several men out the back. These men wear various colored suits—black, brown, red, and blue—and display expressions of alarm. One man in a red jacket is shown falling head-first. On the side of the truck bed, a colorful vertical bar chart is visible. 

At the top, the large black word "TEMPO" is printed. Above it, white text reads "MAIN MATA BOBOL BANK DKI RP 230 MILIAR" and "ARISAN POSISI DINASTI PEJABAT". Below "TEMPO," the date "29 JUNI-5 JULI 2015" appears. To the left, large white text says "PATAH TUMBUH MENTERI BERGANTI," followed by smaller white text: "Siapa bakal dicopot dari Kabinet Kerja Presiden Jokowi?". The bottom right corner contains a barcode, price "RP 39.500," and "ISSN: 0126-4273." A vertical red stripe borders the left edge.
